items.name: (WoL) Mar Sara Town Road — Obedience Billboard

items.name: Tropical Beach — Terran Civilian Crowd

items.name: (WoL) Hyperion Lab — Science Team

items.name: Jungle Tileset — Terran Convoy in Forest

items.name: (LotV) Protoss Cave Shrine — Ancient Banner

items.name: (HotS) Volcanic Boss Encounter — Zerg Colossus

items.name: (WoL) Underground Base — Operations Pad

items.name: (HotS) Space Station Hangar — Armored Transport

items.name: Desert Tileset — Terran vs Zerg Large Battle

items.name: (WoL) Korhal Rain — Industrial Yard at Night

items.name: (WoL) Mar Sara Ruined Town — Desert Cemetery
items.description: Ground-level cinematic view of a desolate desert town with a church tower, gravestones, dead trees, and red banners under a dusty orange sky. Evokes Mar Sara or Korhal wasteland.

items.name: Urban Street — Zerg Encounter
items.description: Ground-level street scene in a ruined city showing Zerg creatures and Terran marines in combat. Background features overgrown urban buildings, suggesting a Zerg-infested colony tileset.

items.name: Zerg Jungle Cave — Bioluminescent Tileset
items.description: Dark alien forest floor with hanging Zerg tendrils and green bioluminescent glow. Two burning Terran vehicles are stranded in the mist of an infested jungle cave.

items.name: (WoL) Bel'Shir Jungle — Protoss Ruins
items.description: Terran characters stand before a glowing green Protoss structure amid lush jungle foliage and massive tree roots. Ancient Protoss ruins on a jungle-world tileset, likely Bel'Shir.

items.name: Ice World Mountain Pass — Panorama
items.description: Wide panoramic view of a snow-covered mountain range with mist and a small Terran outpost visible deep in an icy valley. Pristine ice/snow tileset with no visible combat.

items.name: (WoL) Cantina Interior — Propaganda Room
items.description: Dimly lit interior with a Terran marine, posters reading 'EMPORIO ARMA' and 'VIA Y BRONIA', and screens showing Zerg imagery. Resembles a WoL campaign bar or safe-house interior.

items.name: (HotS) Zerus — Ultralisk vs. Primal Zerg
items.description: Close-up combat between a Zerg Ultralisk and a golden primal Zerg creature on rocky terrain dotted with resource pickups. Zerg spire structures loom in the background, consistent with the Zerus tileset.

items.name: Xel'Naga Cavern — Green Rune Circuit
items.description: Top-down view of a dark cavern with vivid green Xel'Naga energy circuits and alien blade structures. Small units navigate glowing pathways among angular stone formations.

items.name: Xel'Naga Artifact Chamber — Green Crystal
items.description: Close overhead view of a glowing green Xel'Naga crystal mounted on an ornate pedestal, surrounded by dark alien blade structures and neon circuit engravings.

items.name: Xel'Naga Tileset — Overhead Base View
items.description: Top-down overhead of a Xel'Naga-style map with dark hexagonal stone tiles, green glowing Protoss or Xel'Naga structures, and scattered units. Dense circuit-pattern ground texture.

items.name: Xel'Naga Installation — Dark Colossus Structures
items.description: Dark cinematic frame; massive dark Xel'Naga or Protoss constructs loom over a green-glowing tileset. A spire and a hulking mechanical figure dominate the composition.

items.name: Xel'Naga Nexus Structure — Top Down
items.description: Overhead close-up of a large symmetrical Protoss or Xel'Naga hub structure with green energy nodes and orbital sensor dishes, set on a dark circuit-etched stone tileset.

items.name: (LotV) Crystal Cave — Terran Squad
items.description: Dark reflective cave interior with shimmering green-black crystal walls. Terran marines and a Protoss unit are visible ahead, lit by portable floodlights in a narrow passage.

items.name: (WoL) Agria Farmland — Thor on Hillside
items.description: Terran outpost on a golden grass farmland tileset with a massive Thor mech cresting a pine-covered hill. Scattered equipment, turrets, and farm structures fill the foreground.

items.name: (WoL) Agria Grassland — Vehicle Close-Up
items.description: Close-up of a Terran armored vehicle and a Terran character on foot in a golden wheat field beside a large industrial structure. Agricultural planet tileset with warm lighting.

items.name: Ice World — Terran Crash Site with Fauna
items.description: Colorful ice-world tileset with turquoise rivers, pine trees, and a crashed Terran dropship near a radar tower. Terran marines and large white bear-like creatures (Ursadons) populate the snowfield.

items.name: Terran Marines — Blizzard Snow March
items.description: Four Terran marines in full suits trek through a blizzard toward a distant Terran outpost on a snow-covered arctic tileset. Wide cinematic shot suggesting a WoL campaign mission.

items.name: Arctic Ruins — Abandoned Terran Outpost
items.description: A snow-buried Terran building complex with Zerg skeletal remains and debris visible in the foreground. Blizzard arctic tileset showing a derelict base overrun and abandoned.

items.name: Snow Industrial — Zerg Infestation Site
items.description: A large Zerg creature glowing green stands among collapsed Terran structures on a snow-covered industrial tileset. Green energy crystals mark an infestation point amid ruins.

items.name: Terran Capital Ship — Interior Wreckage
items.description: Interior of a massive Terran vessel or station with tall panelled walls, fallen units, and debris on a snow-dusted floor. Zerg green glow visible in lower right corner.

items.name: (WoL) Frozen Tundra — Ice Crystal Valley
items.description: Two Terran units overlook a spectacular icy valley with blue crystal formations, a frozen waterfall, pine forest, and a glowing cyan river under a night sky. Likely a WoL campaign vista.

items.name: Protoss Warp Gate — Alien Biomech Tileset
items.description: A large Protoss/Xel'Naga circular warp gate glowing teal-blue with a figure transiting through it. A Dark Templar unit stands nearby on a dark alien biomechanical floor tileset.

items.name: Protoss Arid — Carrier Platform Overhead
items.description: Top-down view of a gold-toned Protoss structure with symmetrical arms and a pink mineral/psionic crystal at its center. Desert arid tileset with Protoss warriors visible at the edges.

items.name: Protoss Desert — Psionic Crystal Altar
items.description: A large jagged pink psionic crystal sits atop a Protoss circular dais while a robed Protoss executor/high templar stands in attendance. Gold honeycomb desert tileset.

items.name: Kaldir Ice Cave — Submerged Terran Vehicle
items.description: A small Terran vehicle partially submerged in a glowing blue frozen pool inside an ice cave. Kaldir-style glacier tileset with translucent ice walls and crystal formations.

items.name: Terran Naval — Coastal Amphibious Assault
items.description: A large Terran armored transport cuts through ocean water near a tropical island coastline while a Raven-type aircraft hovers above. Coastal island tileset with overcast skies.

items.name: Terran Battlecruiser — Deep Space Profile
items.description: A large Terran capital ship rendered in profile against a star field with a warm nebula dust cloud behind it. Space tileset, no planetary body visible; cinematic model showcase.

items.name: Terran Capital Ship — Engine Glow Variant
items.description: A Terran capital ship at a different angle in deep space, showing glowing orange engine exhaust ports along its hull. Similar space tileset to 837 with a darker star field.

items.name: Korhal Urban — Night Street Level
items.description: Overhead night view of a Terran urban district with elevated platforms, blue-lit screens, and scattered units on dark city streets. Korhal city tileset suggesting a campaign or arcade map.

items.name: Korhal Urban — Night Military Compound
items.description: Dark overhead shot of a Terran military-industrial compound at night with many lit structures, green accents, and perimeter roads. Dense Korhal urban tileset.

items.name: Korhal Cityscape — Illuminated Night District
items.description: Tall Terran city buildings with gold and amber lighting line a night-time urban district with roads and walkways. High-density Korhal city tileset in an arcade or campaign map context.

items.name: Terran Arena — Indoor Combat Facility
items.description: Overhead view of a Terran indoor arena with a racetrack road, blood stains, statues, computer terminals, and containment pools. Suggests an arcade or campaign combat scenario.

items.name: Terran Raven — Fog-Shrouded City Overflight
items.description: A Terran Raven support unit hovers above a hazy blue-grey cityscape. Urban tileset partially obscured by low fog; close-up model shot of the Raven's multi-weapon frame.

items.name: Terran Mech Preview — Campaign Hangar Screen
items.description: A large display screen inside a hangar shows a Thor-class mech while a marine and other Terran units stand in the foreground. Cinematic loading or mission-briefing scene with Zerg flora visible on the right.

items.name: (HotS) Zerg Hero vs Thor — City Under Siege
items.description: A purple-armored Zerg hero figure (possibly Kerrigan) confronts a massive Terran Thor mech amid a snowy urban battlefield with explosions and Zerg flyers overhead. Dramatic HotS campaign cinematic tileset.

items.name: Classic Stone Path — Coastal Cliff Tileset
items.description: A stone-paved road runs along an earthy cliff edge beside bright blue water, with small trees and ancient stone ruins nearby. Classic SC1-era or editor terrain tileset with a rustic coastal biome.

items.name: (WoL) Terran Arena Combat — Gladiator Pit
items.description: Cinematic view of an indoor gladiatorial arena where a heavily armored Terran soldier faces Zerg creatures on a sand floor ringed by barbed wire fencing and spotlights, with a crowd in the background.

items.name: (WoL) Terran vs. Zerg Colossus — Dark Interior
items.description: Dark cinematic close-up of a massive Zerg boss creature with glowing green eyes towering over Terran siege machinery firing at it; industrial interior setting with Zerg forces massed in the background.

items.name: (WoL) Hyperion Command Console — Triple Monitor
items.description: Terran interior scene of a character with dreadlocks seated at a three-screen command station showing StarCraft maps and unit layouts; a chalkboard with equations visible in the background.

items.name: (LotV) Protoss Colossus — Alien Jungle Night
items.description: A large Protoss walker-type construct stands amid dark alien jungle with purple-pink flowering plants and hanging vines at night, with small Zerg creatures visible at its base.

items.name: Terran Space Platform — Gas Giant Orbit
items.description: Space tileset showcasing a large Terran ring-shaped space station in orbit around a ringed gas giant planet, surrounded by drifting asteroids against a star field backdrop.

items.name: Terran Space Station — Close Orbit View
items.description: Close-up cinematic of a Terran orbital platform with a cruciform truss structure and blue running lights, set against a dark nebula and asteroid field in deep space.

items.name: Terran Base — Volcanic Lava Tileset
items.description: Aerial view of a Terran installation with multiple defensive structures and towers set directly on a glowing orange lava flow, representing a Char-style volcanic tileset.

items.name: Terran Outpost — Lava and Ice Border
items.description: Overhead view of a Terran facility positioned at the boundary between flowing lava and icy rocky terrain, featuring defensive towers and a connecting rail or pipeline structure.

items.name: (NCO) Terran Operations Bay — Winter Base
items.description: Aerial view of a snowy Terran hangar labeled 'Operations Bay' with two Terran mechanical walker units stationed outside in a winter environment alongside supply crates and base structures.

items.name: Space Battle — Capital Ships Clash
items.description: Cinematic space combat showing two large capital ships exchanging beam weapon fire, one vessel exploding with electrical arcs and fire while a third ship with blue energy rings observes from the left.

items.name: Space Platform — Beam Weapon Strike
items.description: A large ringed Terran space platform with blue solar panels is struck by a powerful energy beam, erupting in sparks, explosions, and electrical discharges against a dark space background.

items.name: Protoss vs. Zerg — Alien Forest Tileset
items.description: Ground-level view of a multi-race battle on a forested alien world under a purple sky; Protoss structures and stalkers engage Zerg flyers and ground units with Terran or Protoss ships visible overhead.

items.name: (WoL) Terran Fort — Toxic Moat Tileset
items.description: Aerial view of a fortified Terran military outpost on a barren dust tileset, surrounded by a moat of glowing toxic green liquid, with watchtowers, concrete walls, vehicles, and a flag visible inside.

items.name: Terran Interior — Rainy Throne Room
items.description: Dark cinematic shot of a Terran ceremonial interior with red carpet and Terran guards visible in the rain; heavily shadowed with a dramatic high-ceiling perspective suggesting a capital ship or palace setting.

items.name: (WoL) Terran Cantina Interior — SAMMU
items.description: Close-up of a Terran cantina or common room interior featuring a table with stacked credit chips, a blue terminal with 'SAMMU SAM' branding on the wall, and a red-upholstered bench.

items.name: Urban Rooftop — Mar Sara City Tileset
items.description: Overhead aerial view of weathered stone and concrete building rooftops from a Mar Sara or Tarsonis urban tileset, showing detailed staircases, vents, and courtyard elements with sparse trees.

items.name: (HotS) Primal Zerg Boss — Inferno
items.description: Dramatic dark cinematic of an enormous Primal Zerg creature with multiple limbs looming over a horde of smaller Zerg amid raging fire and explosions, suggesting a Zerus campaign encounter.

items.name: Terran Marines vs. Alien Colossus — Desert
items.description: Sun-bleached desert tileset showing Terran marines and troopers fleeing or engaging a massive alien hybrid creature unleashing a lightning arc, with sparse dead trees and sand dunes under a pale sky.

items.name: (WoL) Terran Mech vs. Zerg — Dark Jungle
items.description: Dark cinematic of a Terran mechanical vehicle firing dual flamethrowers or weapons at surrounding Zerg creatures in a dense, shadowy jungle, with bioluminescent Zerg tissue framing the scene.

items.name: Terran Thor vs. Zerg — Ice Planet Tileset
items.description: Winter ice tileset combat scene showing a large Zerg creature (Ultralisk variant) squaring off against a Terran Thor mech, with blue ice crystal formations, snow, and a blizzard in the background.

items.name: Terran Research Lab Interior — Spider Mine Bay
items.description: Terran indoor facility tileset with a mechanical spider mine unit restrained on a platform, scientists and medics nearby, cyan holographic consoles, and a Dominion warning emblem on the wall.

items.name: Zerg Swarm Assault on Dominion Fortress
items.description: Massive Zerg army of zerglings, roaches, hydralisks, and ultralisks advancing across a red-dirt desert tileset toward a fortified Terran Dominion wall with towers and gate.

items.name: Zerg Blizzard Assault — Snow City Tileset
items.description: Large Zerg force including flying units attacking a snow-covered cityscape during a heavy blizzard; snow/urban tileset with skyscraper silhouettes and explosion effects in background.

items.name: Snow Tileset — Medivac Over Frozen Terrain
items.description: Stark white blizzard snow tileset with a Terran Medivac dropship flying low over frozen ground; scattered Zerg ground units and fortified wall visible through heavy snowfall and fog.

items.name: Terran Mechs — Snow Combat Tileset
items.description: Terran Thor walkers and mechanized units engaging enemies on a snow/tundra tileset beside a large Terran base structure; explosions and aircraft visible amid the blizzard.

items.name: Terran Base — Arctic Night Cinematic
items.description: Dark cinematic frame; snow/arctic night tileset showing glowing blue Terran structures and vehicles on a frozen plain under a stormy teal sky with falling snow particles.

items.name: Terran Wreckage — Blizzard Night Scene
items.description: Dark cinematic night snow tileset with burning Terran vehicle wreckage, small infantry figures, and a distant glowing Terran city skyline; heavy snow and low visibility.

items.name: Zerg Aberration — Cracked Barren Tileset
items.description: Close-up of a Zerg creature fused with a Terran metal container on a cracked grey barren-earth tileset; glowing pink tendrils and organic growth visible on the hybrid form.

items.name: Zerg Salvager — Cracked Earth Tileset
items.description: Zerg creature carrying a rusted corrugated-metal Terran container across a cracked, arid grey-earth tileset; spines and organic appendages visible on the unit.

items.name: Dominion Marine and Protoss — Space Cinematic
items.description: Cinematic close-up of a black-armored Dominion Marine and a Protoss unit against a space backdrop featuring a large planet and nearby supernova or stellar explosion.

items.name: Desert Arena — Energy Orb Facility
items.description: Top-down view of a stone desert tileset with an open arena structure containing two pylon-like pylons and a glowing energy sphere; small Terran infantry units visible at the perimeter.

items.name: Ice Cavern — Crystal Cave Tileset
items.description: No units; pristine ice cavern tileset featuring tall blue crystal formations, rocky platforms, and reflective teal pools of water with glowing mineral deposits.

items.name: Jungle Rock Wall — Agria Tileset Flora
items.description: No units; ground-level jungle/Agria tileset showing a dark cracked rock cliff face covered in vines, exotic flowering plants, and small glowing green crystals among the undergrowth.

items.name: Terran Hellion — Dense Jungle Tileset
items.description: Terran Hellion driving through a lush jungle tileset with oversized tree stumps, alien flowers, purple mushrooms, and glowing crystals scattered across a dirt-path floor.

items.name: Rock Golem Neutral Creature — Desert Tileset
items.description: A large quadrupedal rock golem neutral creature with a single glowing eye stands on a barren brown-dirt desert tileset; no other units or structures visible.

items.name: Overgrown Dominion City — Jungle Urban Tileset
items.description: Terran Dominion urban buildings adorned with red faction emblems and golden domes, heavily overgrown with jungle vines and vegetation; a Terran vehicle traverses the street below.

items.name: Jungle City Ruins — Overgrown Urban Tileset
items.description: Abandoned city urban tileset with multi-storey Terran buildings reclaimed by jungle growth and hanging vines; a small Zerg unit is visible on a rooftop, blue accent lights on structures.

items.name: Infested City Street — Jungle Urban Tileset
items.description: Overgrown Terran city street tileset with a curved road, jungle vines overtaking buildings, a Terran transport vehicle, and an infested-looking humanoid figure standing in the foreground.

items.name: Jungle Rail Line — Zerg Viper Encounter
items.description: Jungle tileset featuring a curved dual-rail transport track system; a Zerg Viper hovers in the foreground among alien trees while a Terran rail vehicle moves along the track.

items.name: Terran Battlecruiser — Conifer Forest Tileset
items.description: A large Terran Battlecruiser or capital-class vessel docked among tall conifer trees in a forest tileset; Terran structures and a turret visible to the right through the tree canopy.

items.name: Terran Battlecruiser Docked — Forest Tileset
items.description: Aerial view of a Terran Battlecruiser resting on a landing pad surrounded by dense pine forest on a temperate tileset. A Missile Turret structure is visible to the left.

items.name: Terran Starport — Temperate Tileset Ground View
items.description: Ground-level cinematic view of a large Terran Starport with glowing amber lights amid pine trees and red soil, with a Xel'Naga pyramid structure visible in the background.

items.name: Zerg Creep Cavern — Dark Zerus Tileset
items.description: Dark aerial view of a Zerg-infested rocky cavern with purple-red creep colonies, spore formations, and faint lava cracks. Moody, near-black atmosphere consistent with a Zerus or Char underground tileset.

items.name: Underground Cave — Dark Rock Tileset with Minerals
items.description: Aerial view of a dark underground rocky tileset with deep purple-brown stone formations. A small blue mineral crystal cluster is visible at centre-left, and a faint unit silhouette appears near the top.

items.name: Subterranean Grotto — Teal Mist Cave Tileset
items.description: Underground cave scene featuring teal glowing water, dark organic rock columns, Zerg-like mushroom formations, and a small blue mineral crystal. Misty atmosphere suggests a deep cavern or Zerg lair tileset.

items.name: Cave Grotto with Rock Arch — Underground Tileset
items.description: Dark underground grotto with a natural rock arch framing an opening to a brighter area. A small unit and a blue mineral crystal are visible on the cave floor, with purple ambient lighting.

items.name: Jungle Waterfall — Bel'Shir Tileset (Aerial View)
items.description: Bright aerial view of a lush tropical jungle tileset featuring a vivid cyan waterfall, sandy dirt paths, dense foliage, palm-like plants, and moss-covered boulders. Consistent with a Bel'Shir or jungle tileset.

items.name: Orbital Bombardment Cinematic — Terran City Destruction
items.description: Dramatic cinematic frame looking upward at a massive orbital explosion engulfing a Terran cityscape, with buildings, Terran infantry, and vehicles being hurled into the air. No playable tileset visible.

items.name: Dark Forest Path — Night Cinematic Frame
items.description: Nearly pitch-black cinematic frame of a narrow forest path lined with dark foliage reflecting faint light. Dark cinematic frame; terrain details largely indiscernible but consistent with a night-jungle environment.

items.name: Coastal Fortress — Sepia Cinematic Aerial
items.description: Sepia-toned cinematic aerial shot of a walled fortress city on a rocky coastal promontory, with towers, dense structures inside the walls, and surrounding cliffs and water. Ancient architecture, no race units visible.

items.name: Misty Valley with Rock Spires — Sepia Landscape
items.description: Sepia-toned cinematic landscape of a misty mountain valley with tall rock spires and pine trees in the foreground; Zerg structures and a settlement are visible on a distant plateau above the cliffs.

items.name: Ancient Stone Tower — Jungle Cliff Cinematic
items.description: Sepia-toned ground-level cinematic view of an ornate multi-storey stone tower perched on rocky cliffs surrounded by jungle vegetation and hanging vines. Architecture appears ancient and non-Terran.

items.name: Palisade Fortification — Cliff Edge Cinematic
items.description: Sepia-toned cinematic view of a circular wooden palisade fortification on a rocky cliff edge, with large hanging organic tendrils above and misty jungle visible below. Atmosphere suggests a Zerg-influenced environment.

items.name: Alien Jungle — Mushroom Rock Pillar Tileset
items.description: Ground-level view of a lush alien jungle tileset with tall vegetation-topped rock pillars, palm-like foliage, sandy ground, and rolling mist. Consistent with an Aiur or Protoss jungle world tileset.

items.name: Blizzard Hockey Arcade — Snow Rink Map
items.description: Top-down aerial view of a snow-surface hockey arena with Terran Marines and Zerg units competing. "Blizzard" branded signage lines the boards; green circle markers indicate player positions.

items.name: Merry Christmas Holiday — All-Race Arcade Map
items.description: Snow tileset arcade scene showing SC2 units from all three races (Terran, Zerg, Protoss) gathered around a lit Christmas tree with a campfire. Text reads "MERRY CHRISTMAS" in a holiday special map.

items.name: SC2 Hockey Rink — Arcade Stadium Overview
items.description: Isometric overview of a full ice hockey rink custom arcade map with radiation-symbol face-off circles, blue and red lines, Terran-style stadium seating, and spectator units ringing the perimeter.

items.name: SC2 Mapston Hockey Rink — Ice Surface Close-Up
items.description: Close-up top-down view of an ice hockey rink arcade map showing radiation-symbol markings, a gold-star insignia, and "SC2 MAPSTON" branding on the ice. A Cyrillic "Бета-банк" billboard is visible on the boards.

items.name: Terran Industrial Side-Scroller — Pipe Facility Map
items.description: Side-scrolling custom arcade or campaign map inside a Terran industrial pipe facility, with Marines navigating large pipes and machinery. A mechanical boss face with a radiation hazard symbol looms in the background.

items.name: Ruined Terran City — Desert Wasteland Cinematic
items.description: Cinematic ground-level shot of a fortified Terran bunker complex atop rubble in a destroyed desert city, with industrial gun turrets and ruined skyscrapers stretching to a hazy mountain horizon.

items.name: Terran Fortress — Dusty Canyon Base
items.description: Aerial view of a fortified Terran base with bunkers and supply depots arranged in a circular layout on a barren rocky canyon tileset. Zerg units are visible advancing along the cliffs in the background.

items.name: Terran Command Center — Ruined Badlands
items.description: Close-up of a heavily armored Terran Command Center or bunker complex on a dusty badlands tileset, surrounded by industrial ruins and missile turrets.

items.name: Terran Heavy Platform — Rocky Wasteland
items.description: A massive Terran industrial structure or siege platform perched on rocky terrain, flanked by crumbling high-rise ruins on a dusty wasteland tileset.

items.name: Terran vs Protoss — Desert Battlefield
items.description: Intense battle between Terran mech units and Protoss forces on a sandy desert tileset, with explosions, Protoss energy projectiles, and casualties scattered across the battlefield.

items.name: Hybrid — Dark Shrine Assault
items.description: Cinematic ground-level shot of a massive Protoss/Hybrid construct firing red laser beams under a dark purple sky. Glowing Xel'Naga glyphs and Zerg structures are visible in the background.

items.name: Terran vs Zerg — Ice Tileset Night Assault
items.description: Night battle on a snow and ice tileset with a large Zerg Hive complex at center, Terran Thor and infantry attacking, and a Protoss Carrier visible in the upper-right corner.

items.name: Terran Marines — Snowy Crash Site
items.description: Terran Marines and Spectres investigate a burning crashed vehicle on a dark snow tileset. Additional armored units are visible approaching across the snowfield.

items.name: Terran Battlecruiser — Stormy Rocky Shore
items.description: Cinematic low-angle shot of a Terran Battlecruiser grounded or hovering over a rocky shoreline during a heavy storm with lightning. Dark and atmospheric scene.

items.name: Arctic Lakeshore — Classic Tileset Preview
items.description: SC1-era art style landscape showing a peaceful lakeshore with pine trees, snow-capped mountains, sandy beach, and a small Terran outpost in the distance.

items.name: Jungle Canyon — Protoss Artifact Cavern
items.description: Overhead aerial view of a deep jungle canyon filled with tropical vegetation and glowing blue Protoss artifact markers. Dark rocky cliffs frame the dense foliage below.

items.name: Jungle Path — Protoss Rune Stones
items.description: Ground-level view of a lush alien jungle tileset with glowing Protoss rune stones etched in orange and blue. Protoss structures and a large mech unit are visible through the foliage.

items.name: Zerg Organism — Asset Preview Sphere
items.description: Isolated asset preview of a dark spherical Zerg or Xel'Naga organism with glowing red and cyan energy bands, displayed against a black background.

items.name: Zerg Organism — Top-Down Asset View
items.description: Top-down asset preview of a circular dark mechanical or biological structure with concentric rings and a glowing blue outer rim, on a black background.

items.name: Protoss Interior — Glowing Circuit Tiles
items.description: Protoss or Xel'Naga interior tileset featuring glowing blue circuit pathways on dark stone floors, illuminated crystal pylons, and purple-green atmospheric lighting.

items.name: Underground Crystal Cavern — Zerg Tileset
items.description: Underground cavern environment with jagged crystal spires glowing in teal, green, and purple hues. Atmospheric shafts of light beam down from above onto a misty cave floor.

items.name: Jungle Boardwalk — Forest Tileset Path
items.description: SC1-era art style stone or wooden boardwalk winding through a dense jungle tileset with ferns, palm fronds, and tall tropical grasses on either side.

items.name: Dark Rainy Forest — Jungle Road
items.description: Dark cinematic frame of a rain-drenched forest road flanked by large trees, with misty light visible at the end of the path. No units visible; atmospheric jungle environment.

items.name: Jungle Swamp — Wooden Bridge Crossing
items.description: Ground-level view of a jungle swamp tileset with a wooden bridge over murky water, willow-like trees, and two blue bird-like creatures (local fauna) in the foreground.

items.name: Pine Forest Valley — Twilight Landscape
items.description: Expansive landscape view of a pine forest valley beneath overcast skies, with dark mountains and a marshy lake beyond. A yellow dashed path marker is faintly visible on the hillside.

items.name: Desert Canyon — Map Editor Terrain Overview
items.description: SC2 editor terrain height-map preview of a desert canyon tileset with red-orange cliffs surrounding a teal river/lake basin and small island peaks. No units; map design tool view.

items.name: Jungle Swamp Waterline
items.description: Ground-level view of a murky jungle swamp with algae-covered water and mossy cliff faces draped in dense green foliage. No units visible; atmospheric tileset diorama.

items.name: Temperate Forest Lake Shore
items.description: Panoramic view of a vivid blue lake surrounded by pine-forested hills under an overcast sky. No units present; showcases a temperate forest/lake tileset.

items.name: Jungle Road with Terran Barriers
items.description: Ground-level shot of a cracked jungle road flanked by Terran metal barriers and lush tropical trees including palms. Terran structures line the path with no active units visible.

items.name: Dark Cave Terran Outpost with Screens
items.description: Dark cinematic frame; dimly lit underground cave with glowing holographic monitors, fire, and figures around Terran crates on rocky reddish terrain. Campaign-style interior scene.

items.name: Terran Marine Close-Up Red Structure
items.description: Close-up low-angle shot of a Terran marine in red armor standing beside a large red industrial structure bearing a small flag. Industrial Terran tileset detail.

items.name: Terran Base Tarmac — Thor and Vehicles
items.description: Isometric view of a Terran facility tarmac with a Thor mech, SCVs, a Battlecruiser transport, and various vehicles. Paved base area adjoining a forested edge.

items.name: (NCO) Urban Night Combat — Neon City Street
items.description: Dark sci-fi city street at night with Terran soldiers in black armor, burning vehicles, green-lit floating drones, and neon-lit signage. Nova Covert Ops urban tileset.

items.name: Night Combat — Silhouetted Melee Fight
items.description: Dark cinematic frame; silhouetted figures engaged in close combat under a full moon with fires burning across a jungle/swamp backdrop. Race uncertain; campaign cutscene lighting.

items.name: Dark Bioluminescent Rocky Waterway
items.description: Aerial top-down view of a dark rocky waterway with glimmering bioluminescent plants along the banks. No units visible; moody alien or Zerg-adjacent tileset.

items.name: Glacial Ice Cave — Terran Outpost Plain
items.description: Inside a vast ice cave looking out over a snowy plain where small Terran structures are visible. Towering ice crystal formations fill the cavern ceiling.

items.name: Protoss Stone Fortress — Starlit Forest
items.description: Nighttime exterior of a stone fortress with glowing lanterns set into a pine-forested rocky hillside under a star-filled sky. Protoss or mixed-race architecture; no units present.

items.name: Glacial Crystal Cave Tunnel
items.description: Interior of an ice crystal cave with interlocking arched blue-white formations framing a dark passage. A small unit silhouette is faintly visible deep inside the tunnel.

items.name: Ice Spire Ridgeline — Terran Ship Flyover
items.description: Low-angle view of jagged ice crystal spires under a purple blizzard sky with a small Terran ship (possibly a Wraith) flying overhead. Snow/glacial tileset exterior.

items.name: Terran Arctic Base — Radar and Glacier
items.description: Interior of a Terran Arctic facility looking out through a gate onto a snowy plain with twin radar dishes, green floor markings, and glacial ice formations in the background.

items.name: Post-Apocalyptic Desert City — Cyrillic Neon
items.description: Ruined urban streetscape at dusk with crumbling tower blocks, neon signs in Cyrillic and Asian scripts, smoke stacks, and red glow. Sign reads 'Aiur – Zergs are here' in Russian.

items.name: (LotV) Glacial Ice Mountain — Protoss Spire

items.name: Space Combat — Red Nebula Ship Wreckage

items.name: Terran Battlecruiser — Space Near Red Planet

items.name: Jungle Floating Platform — Combat Scene

items.name: Ancient Stone Ruins — Torch-Lit Crypt

items.name: Protoss Base — Nexus Compound Top-Down

items.name: Zerg Jungle Waterfall — Char/Zerus Biome

items.name: Terran Asteroid Base — Space Platform
items.description: Terran military base built on a rocky asteroid in outer space with a large planet looming nearby; Terran structures, vehicles, and a secondary Zerg-occupied platform visible below.

items.name: Terran Space-Rock Outpost — Neon Billboard

items.name: Zerg Fleet — Brood Lords Bombarding Planet

items.name: Terran Vehicle Bay — Sandy Jungle Outpost

items.name: Terran Perimeter Fence — Mar Sara Sandy Base

items.name: Jungle Tileset — Protoss Circular Clearing

items.name: Terran Flag Raise — Cinematic Silhouette Skyline

items.name: Arcade Neon City Explosion — Custom Tileset
items.description: Vibrant arcade custom map with neon blue and red platforms, humanoid figures, and a massive gold energy explosion. Highly stylized non-standard tileset for arcade use.

items.name: Korhal City Street — Intact vs Destroyed Split
items.description: Wide Terran city street showing a clean sci-fi district on the left transitioning to bombed-out ruins on the right, with a capital ship in the overcast sky. Korhal urban tileset.

items.name: Terran City Baseball Field — Arcade Sports Map
items.description: Night scene of a baseball diamond surrounded by hedges and stadium lights, with neon ad boards reading 'Terran Memoirs' and 'Au Crédit à Picole'. Custom Terran city arcade map.

items.name: Terran Industrial Yard — Hazard Striping and Fences

items.name: Underground Crystal Cavern — Mineral Cave Tileset

items.name: Terran Army — Desert Wasteland Battle

items.description: Close-up of a Protoss or advanced sci-fi interior featuring robotic assembly arms on raised platforms with blue-white lighting. Likely an editor or arcade custom map tileset.

items.description: Isometric view of a fenced Terran compound with stacked cargo containers, chain-link fencing, and small figures inside. Set in an arid canyon with green-cliff walls, suggesting a WoL-era facility map.

items.name: Dark Volcanic Hall — Lava Floor and Stone Archway
items.description: Dark stone corridor with a lava-covered floor leading up broad stairs to an arched gateway. Purple energy orbs and orange-emblazoned banners line the passage walls.

items.name: Terran Orbital Platform — Top-Down Energy Array
items.description: Close overhead view of a circular Terran high-tech platform with orange glowing energy emitters arranged symmetrically around a central cannon. Honeycomb panels cover the surface.

items.name: Protoss Desert Base — Waterfalls and Pylons
items.description: Aerial view of an expansive Protoss desert settlement with sandy tileset, multiple Protoss structures, waterfall channels, green vegetation, and Terran units nearby on the left flank.

items.name: Protoss Desert Corridor — Waterfall Flanks
items.description: Ornate Protoss desert corridor flanked by tall waterfall-topped tower platforms. A lone Protoss hero unit stands on the central glowing path amid teal-lit architecture.

items.name: Protoss Interior — Garden Pools and Nexus Area
items.description: Overhead view of an indoor Protoss facility featuring blue glowing pools, lush garden beds, tall spire structures, and circular platform motifs. A few Protoss units are present.

items.name: (LotV) Protoss Night Plaza — Pylons and Obelisk
items.description: Ground-level night view of a Protoss plaza with rows of glowing pylons, a towering blue crystal obelisk, and orbital platforms overhead. A Protoss hero figure stands at center.

items.name: Protoss Coastal Platform — Misty Water Terrain
items.description: Protoss architectural platform extending over misty gray water with blue energy columns, decorative circular motifs, and a Terran marine unit visible at the lower edge.

items.name: Jungle Tileset — Bel'Shir Cliffside
items.description: Lush jungle biome with dense trees, mossy rocky cliffs, and a water channel at the left. Protoss structures are visible at the upper-right edge of the verdant terrain.

items.name: Dark Jungle Ruins — Gnarled Trees and Statues
items.description: Dark atmospheric swamp-jungle tileset with gnarled ancient trees, stone ruin walkways, misty low fog, and weathered Protoss-style statues rising from the undergrowth.

items.name: Dense Jungle Floor — Dark Canopy Undergrowth
items.description: Close aerial view of a dense dark jungle floor with a large fallen log crossing rocky terrain, surrounded by ferns, mossy boulders, and thick tropical undergrowth. No units visible.

items.name: Protoss Jungle Ruins — Crystal Pylon
items.description: Overgrown Protoss ruins tileset with stone pathways, a glowing blue crystal pylon, and dense foliage. Dark Aiur-style jungle with rocky cliffs and ancient Protoss architecture.

items.name: Protoss Dark Ruins — Twisted Forest
items.description: Corrupted jungle ruins tileset featuring cracked stone paving, twisted dark trees, and scattered Protoss ruin fragments. Atmospheric and shadowy, reminiscent of Shakuras or fallen Aiur.

items.name: Dense Jungle Ravine — No Structures
items.description: Pure jungle/forest terrain with heavy tree canopy, mossy boulders, and faint glowing particles. No units or structures visible; dark natural biome suitable for Aiur or jungle tileset.

items.name: Protoss Jungle Base — Nexus Clearing
items.description: Protoss nexus-like structure with blue circular glows nestled in a rocky jungle clearing. Curved Protoss architecture and glowing energy conduits on a dark forest tileset.

items.name: Protoss Ancient Ruins — Mixed Terrain
items.description: Protoss golden structures including gateways and pylons on a grassy dirt terrain with Zerg biomass visible on the left. Blue crystals and ancient Protoss arches in a mixed biome map.

items.name: Protoss Floating Islands — Void Edge
items.description: Protoss structures on misty floating rock platforms above water, with a void boundary visible at the map edge. Shakuras-style tileset with blue-accented pylons and foggy atmosphere.

items.name: Protoss Aquatic Base — Dense Settlement
items.description: Dense Protoss base on a teal aquatic tileset with Nexus, pylons, gateways, blue mineral crystals, and a heroic Protoss character unit. Highly detailed multiplayer or arcade map layout.

items.name: Protoss Desert Base — Pylon Cluster
items.description: Close overhead view of a Protoss base on sandy desert terrain with multiple pylons, gateways, and a Dark Templar-style unit. Blue energy glows on golden Protoss structures.

items.name: Protoss Interior — Command Chamber
items.description: Split interior view of a Protoss command facility with glowing blue panels, a holographic globe, and a Protoss Immortal unit. Detailed indoor Protoss architecture, likely a campaign level.

items.name: Protoss Desert Oasis — Waterway
items.description: Protoss desert tileset with a winding water channel, palm trees, waterfalls, and blue-glowing Protoss structures. Decorative oasis environment on golden sandy terrain.

items.name: Protoss Desert Garden — Oasis Channel
items.description: Aerial view of a curved Protoss waterway with lush palm trees, waterfalls, and ornamental blue-lit structures on sandy desert terrain. Scenic tileset showcase or editor diorama.

items.name: Protoss Desert Tileset — Dual Pools
items.description: Two Protoss-bordered pools on a sandy terrain with blue energy accents and a small Protoss structure cluster. Clean map editor view demonstrating Protoss desert water features.

items.name: Protoss Aquatic Hub — Central Nexus
items.description: Protoss Nexus-style hub structure surrounded by water channels, lush foliage, and golden Protoss architecture with blue highlights. Tropical aquatic tileset with waterfall details.

items.name: Protoss Metallic Platform — Pylon Array
items.description: Close overhead view of a dense Protoss metallic platform with pylons, energy turrets, and blue glowing conduits on a grid-patterned floor. Protoss ship or space platform interior tileset.

items.name: (LotV) Protoss Warriors — Cinematic Group
items.description: Ground-level cinematic view of Protoss hero characters including an Immortal, a robed Executor, and High Templar units. A Phoenix flies overhead amid golden Protoss spires.

items.name: Protoss Desert Outpost — Tower Grid
items.description: Overhead view of a sandy Protoss desert tileset with circular pylon towers, energy pylons, and scattered small units including a Zerg Hydralisk. Multiplayer or arcade map layout.

items.name: Protoss Base — Nexus with Blue Flame
items.description: Protoss base on sandy terrain featuring a Nexus with a blue energy flame, Stalker and Dark Templar units, and a fortified tower structure in the background. Active multiplayer-style map.

items.name: Protoss Map Editor — Tileset Showcase
items.description: Isometric editor view of a Protoss golden tileset with pylons, Zealots, High Templar, and blue-lit structures. Map boundary clearly visible; appears to be a terrain showcase or tutorial map.

items.name: Protoss Misty Archipelago — Dense Fleet
items.description: Sprawling Protoss map on a misty aquatic tileset with numerous Nexuses, Phoenix carriers, blue mineral crystals, pylons, and tall trees. Foggy atmosphere suggesting a large arcade or skirmish map.

items.name: Terran Siege Tanks — Desert Outpost
items.description: Three Terran Siege Tanks deployed on a sandy desert tileset surrounded by dust haze. Barricades and a lone infantry unit occupy the fortified courtyard.

items.name: Terran Platform Edge — Jungle Tileset
items.description: Terran reinforced platform with red warning lights and pipe conduits at the edge of a dense jungle cliff. Dark sci-fi installation tileset with lush foliage below.

items.name: Terran Interior — DANGER Zone Platform
items.description: Dark Terran space-platform interior with armoured walls and red beacon lights. The floor bears a legible "DANGER" marking; a small unit stands near the fortified gate.

items.name: Terran Installation — Forest Perimeter
items.description: Terran armoured structure with red warning lights nestled among dense conifer trees on a dark forest tileset. A small vehicle unit is visible near the building entrance.

items.name: Terran Research Station — Dark Interior
items.description: Top-down view of a dimly lit Terran laboratory interior with cargo crates, machinery, and a central hatch. Red atmospheric lighting and atomic-symbol markings line the walls.

items.name: Terran Fortified Compound — Enclosed Courtyard
items.description: Terran armoured compound with atomic-symbol insignia and red accent lighting enclosing a natural courtyard of trees and rocky terrain. A screen display is visible on the wall.

items.name: Sword-Bearing Mech — Forest Tileset
items.description: Large stone-and-metal mech unit wielding a broad sword stands on a mossy forest tileset. Glowing blue eyes and resource UI icons visible; likely an arcade or custom map hero unit.

items.name: Ancient Ruins Altar — Lava Cracked Tileset
items.description: Stone-paved ancient tileset with lava cracks and a central burning ritual altar. Dark Templar-style units and beast-riders flank the shrine in a lava-veined ruins map.

items.name: Protoss Ancient Ruins — Lava Battlefield Overview
items.description: Wide aerial view of a Protoss ancient-ruins tileset with lava fissures, stone obelisks, and warrior statues. A campfire burns near a pyramid structure in the mid-ground.

items.name: Terran Factory Floor — Industrial Interior
items.description: Terran industrial factory interior with yellow floor lane markings numbered 201 and 202, mechanical crane arms, and Terran infantry workers along the corridor.

items.name: Terran Hangar Bay — Launch Pad Interior
items.description: Terran hangar interior showing a large circular floor hatch with yellow hazard stripes. Machinery, a crane tower, and scattered equipment surround the central landing pad.

items.name: Protoss Interior Corridor — Blue-Lit Architecture
items.description: Elegant Protoss interior with tall blue-glowing pillars and ornate wall panels. A single small Protoss unit stands in the centre of the illuminated corridor.

items.name: Protoss Research Chamber — Specimen Pods
items.description: Protoss facility interior lined with glowing orange spherical containment pods housing Zerg specimens. Ornate Protoss architecture with teal accent lighting fills the chamber.

items.name: Protoss Command Centre — Grand Interior Hall
items.description: Sweeping Protoss command hall with tiered platforms, multiple containment spheres, and a central circular floor disc. Blue and gold lighting highlights ornate Protoss stonework.

items.name: Terran Desert Deployment — Mar Sara Tileset
items.description: Large Terran force including Marines, vehicles, and mechs massed on a red-sand desert tileset. Dead trees and a forward base structure occupy the barren Mar Sara-style landscape.

items.name: Arena Battle — Jungle Coliseum Tileset
items.description: Stone-walled arena set on a lush green grass tileset surrounded by dark jungle. Zerg and other mixed units clash in the central pit of what appears to be an arcade map arena.

items.name: Korhal City Plaza — Blizzard Sign
items.description: Urban Korhal city tileset with a grand plaza and a legible "BLIZZARD" neon sign on a central building. Terran infantry, vehicles, and fireworks populate the celebratory scene.

items.name: Snowy Night — Holiday Tree and Dark Hero
items.description: Snowy pine-forest tileset at night with a decorated holiday tree crowned by a glowing phoenix. A dark-robed hero unit overlooks small mixed forces gathered around the tree.

items.name: Protoss Dark Shrine — Jungle Twilight
items.description: A large Protoss dark shrine with glowing red accents flanked by smaller Nerazim structures on a jungle/twilight tileset beneath a purple and crimson nebula sky.

items.name: Jungle Island Aerial — Twilight Tileset
items.description: Overhead map-editor view of a lush jungle island floating in space against a dark purple nebula. A Protoss dark structure is visible at the northern edge.

items.name: Nerazim Monument Field — Jungle Cinematic
items.description: Ground-level cinematic of Protoss/Nerazim obelisks and a dark shrine surrounded by dense jungle foliage under a vivid crimson nebula sky. No units present.

items.name: Volcanic Lava Terrain — Crystal Outcrops
items.description: Close aerial view of a dark volcanic tileset with clusters of pink and purple mineral crystals growing from cracked rock. Red lava veins glow throughout the terrain. No units.

items.name: Volcanic Tileset — Lava Cracks and Crystals
items.description: Aerial view of a dark volcanic/infested tileset showing pink crystal clusters, cracked lava terrain, and dark angular structures with Protoss or Terran markings in the upper corner.

items.name: Protoss Warp Gate — Lava World Interior
items.description: Close-up of a dark Protoss gateway structure with molten lava glowing through its interior, surrounded by angular dark stone spires on a volcanic cracked-rock tileset.

items.name: Protoss Nexus — Crimson Nebula Backdrop
items.description: Dramatic close-up of a large dark Protoss structure (nexus or hub) on rocky terrain against a glowing red and purple nebula. Cinematic/artistic presentation with no units visible.

items.name: Floating Island Silhouette — Space Nebula
items.description: Dark silhouette of a lone tree on a floating rocky island set against a vivid red, purple, and teal nebula. Artistic/loading-screen style; no units identifiable.

items.name: Twilight Forest Rocks — Nebula Sky
items.description: Ground-level view of large trees on a rocky twilight/jungle tileset beneath a vivid pink and purple nebula sky. Terrain showcase with no units present.

items.name: Terran Space Platform — Orbital Tileset
items.description: Oblique aerial view of a Terran space station tileset with metal plating, stacked cargo crates, and small Terran infantry. A planet with a bright corona is visible in the background.

items.name: Terran Industrial Facility Interior
items.description: Interior of a large Terran industrial facility with red-lit wall panels, heavy columns, and various Terran units including infantry and small vehicles. Campaign interior tileset.

items.name: Terran Lab — Cryo Pod Bay
items.description: Different angle of a Terran interior facility showing rows of blue-glowing cryo/stasis pods, machinery, and Terran units. Red overhead panels line the ceiling. Campaign lab tileset.

items.name: Terran Hangar — Marine Stasis Pods
items.description: Terran interior scene with rows of stasis cryo-pods and Terran marines in the foreground; one marine is highlighted with a glowing blue ability effect. Campaign hangar/lab tileset.

items.name: Terran Pod Bay — Hangar Interior
items.description: Large Terran hangar interior with symmetrical rows of red-lit storage pods and heavy columns. Multiple Terran marines are visible on the floor. Suggests a WoL or NCO campaign scene.

items.name: Terran Cryo Hangar — Infantry Deployment
items.description: Wide interior Terran hangar with red-lit cryo pod rows and marines. A large cylindrical structure occupies the center foreground. Campaign interior tileset, possibly Wings of Liberty.

items.name: Terran Battlecruiser Dock — Hangar Bay
items.description: Cinematic view of a massive Terran hangar with a large docked warship or transport, overhead crane lights, and infantry assembling below. Campaign cutscene interior tileset.

items.name: Terran Mech Hangar — Bay Door View
items.description: View from inside a Terran hangar looking outward through bay doors. Large Terran mech units (Goliath/Thor-class) flank the entrance; vehicles and ships visible in the interior beyond.

items.name: Terran Dropship Bay — Crew Assembly
items.description: Terran hangar scene with a parked dropship/transport and a group of Terran marines and crew gathered nearby. Industrial equipment and green-tinted lighting surround them. Campaign interior.

items.name: Terran Indoor Factory Hangar
items.description: Interior of a large Terran industrial hangar with mechanical cranes, red warning lights, and heavy vehicles including a Thor mech and hover bikes on the floor.

items.name: Terran Station — Lunar Surface
items.description: A compact Terran space station module with blue lights and dual landing pads rests on a barren dark moon tileset with lava fissures visible in the background.

items.name: Terran Outpost — Moon Hex Platform
items.description: A modular Terran outpost built on interlocking hexagonal platforms on a dark lunar surface, featuring red-lit turrets, hover bikes, and small air units.

items.name: Terran Fortress Block — Lunar Tileset
items.description: A multi-storey Terran fortified structure with red-glowing interior corridors sits on a dark rocky moon tileset; no active units visible.

items.name: Underground Cave — Bone Scatter Biome
items.description: Dark underground cave tileset with blue mineral crystals, scattered skeletal remains on the rocky floor, and dark spore-like vegetation; no units present.

items.name: (HotS) Dark Cave Ambush Scene
items.description: Dark cinematic cave frame; a small creature stands on a rocky floor surrounded by shadowy Zerg-like forms and glowing orange spore clusters in a dim cavern.

items.name: (LotV) Dark Protoss Cave — Cannon Beam
items.description: Dark Protoss underground cave with green-glowing architectural elements; a large cannon fires a teal energy beam at massed Zerg units among Zerg-infested walls.

items.name: (LotV) Protoss Green Crystal Cavern
items.description: Lush green-lit underground cave with Protoss rune pillars; a large Zerg creature looms in the background as a hero unit engages in close combat near the entrance.

items.name: (LotV) Protoss Cave — Air Unit Assault
items.description: Green crystal Protoss underground tileset; a Protoss air unit fires a teal beam at Zerg forces scattered across a circular rune floor flanked by Protoss pillars.

items.name: (LotV) Void Tileset — Protoss Ritual Platform
items.description: Dark red-atmospheric underground area with a Protoss circular platform glowing blue at center, surrounded by skeletal infested structures outlined in neon green.

items.name: Arcade — Rorch Desert Ruins Arena
items.description: Arcade map UI showing hero 'Rorch, The Lave Beetle' on a sandy desert ruins tileset with stone platforms, palm trees, and a glowing blue portal; score 1500 vs 1500.

items.name: Arcade — Rorch Desert Shrine Platform
items.description: Arcade map close-up of an ancient stone arena on desert ruins tileset; circular glowing objective ring visible, hero 'Rorch, The Lave Beetle' shown in the HUD.

items.name: Arcade — Desert Ruins Map Overview
items.description: Full overhead view of an arcade map on a sandy desert/jungle ruins tileset; multiple shrine platforms, two large Zerg flying units flanking the island, and winding paths visible.

items.name: (HotS) Kerrigan — Volcanic Standoff Cinematic
items.description: Cinematic scene on a dark volcanic Zerg-infested tileset; a glowing winged entity (Kerrigan) stands atop a rise flanked by Terran Thor mechs and a massed Zerg swarm under a red sky.

items.name: (HotS) Kerrigan Zerg Charge — Marine Defense
items.description: Cinematic frame on a volcanic red-sky tileset; Zerg forces charge past a glowing Kerrigan figure toward entrenched Terran Marines firing from sandbag positions in the foreground.

items.name: (LotV) Protoss Cockpit — Aerial Battle
items.description: First-person cinematic from inside a Protoss vessel; glowing blue energy shield and cannon in foreground, massive Protoss-vs-Zerg aerial battle visible on a dark planet surface below.

items.name: Flooded Urban Ruins — Zerg Infestation
items.description: Overhead view of a ruined urban tileset with building rooftops separated by flooded teal waterways; Zerg infestation and green units visible among overgrown abandoned structures.

items.name: Protoss Nexus — Golden Tileset Mineral Field
items.description: Protoss Nexus surrounded by glowing green mineral clusters and blue energy orbs on a sandy golden tileset; circular Protoss architecture with a Probe visible near the base.

items.name: Terran Floating Island Mining Platform
items.description: Terran floating island with mining equipment and Zerg infestation glow, connected by a bridge over aqua water to a cracked highland tileset. Editor showcase of elevated platform terrain.

items.name: Terran Desert Combat — Marines and Siege Hardware
items.description: Close-up of Terran marines and a large mechanical unit on cracked desert terrain beside a massive armored platform or battlecruiser hull. Arid wasteland tileset.

items.name: Terran Interior — CAUTION Facility Floor
items.description: Dark sci-fi Terran interior with "CAUTION" text marked on the floor panels, featuring modular crate and console doodads. Editor interior space tileset with dim amber lighting.

items.name: Terran Command Briefing Room — Holographic Displays
items.description: Terran interior briefing room with two characters and glowing holographic screens showing unit schematics and maps. Campaign-style cinematic interior tileset.

items.name: (NCO) Nova — Energy Blade Combat Cinematic
items.description: Cinematic frame of a female Terran operative in white armor wielding a glowing blue energy sword amid fire and wreckage. Dark cinematic frame; likely Nova Covert Ops cutscene.

items.name: Terran Cave Outpost — Command Tower on Catwalks
items.description: Terran marines patrol catwalks around a large dark command tower inside a dimly lit cave with rocky walls and spotlight beams. Underground cave tileset with Terran industrial structures.

items.name: Terran Industrial Dock — Cave Water Platform
items.description: Massive Terran industrial platform with cranes, pipes, and cargo over dark water flanked by icy cave cliffs. Heavy-industry cave tileset with multi-level deck structures.

items.name: Terran Cave Pipeline Bridge — Water Chasm
items.description: Narrow Terran industrial pipeline bridge with blue lights and steam vents stretching over a dark water chasm in a cave. A lone marine stands atop a vent structure.

items.name: Terran Industrial Dock — Lava Water Combat
items.description: Terran marine and mech unit skirmish on an industrial dock over lava-tinted water with red fish visible below. Dockyard platform tileset with atmospheric lighting.

items.name: Terran Cave Battleship Platform — Icy Water
items.description: Large Terran industrial battleship-like structure with heavy turrets set over dark icy water surrounded by cliff walls. Atmospheric underground water and ice tileset.

items.name: Terran Arena — Sand Pit with Zerg Units
items.description: Walled sandy arena with Zerg units (hydralisks) inside and a Terran gate on the right wall. Gladiatorial arcade map with desert sand tileset enclosed by reinforced walls.

items.name: Terran Campaign Briefing — Window Overlooking Badlands
items.description: Two Terran characters study holographic equations inside a ship interior overlooking a barren badlands landscape through a large window. Campaign cinematic interior scene.

items.name: Terran Volcanic Facility — EXHAUST Zone
items.description: Terran industrial corridor with an "EXHAUST" warning sign adjacent to flowing lava on the volcanic tileset. Pink grid lines and machinery mark the active hazard zone.

items.name: Ruined Terran Industrial District — Post-Battle
items.description: Destroyed Terran urban-industrial zone with crumbled structures, scattered debris, and small fires. Post-apocalyptic city ruins tileset with dim torch lighting.

items.name: Terran Interior Arena — Heavy Mech Encounter
items.description: Terran sci-fi interior facility with a large multi-barreled mech unit (Thor-like) in the central chamber surrounded by corridors and turret emplacements. Combat arena tileset.

items.name: Terran Lava Prison — MESS HALL Corridor
items.description: Terran prison complex interior labeled "MESS HALL" with lava flooding through pink neon-lit corridors. Volcanic emergency scenario tileset with magenta accent lighting.

items.name: Terran Lava Prison — Maximum Security Complex
items.description: Terran prison facility with "INFIRMARY", "MESS HALL", and "MAXIMUM SECURITY" signs surrounded by lava. A Terran vehicle is visible on the landing pad amid the volcanic tileset.

items.name: (WoL) Mengsk Throne Room — Terran-Protoss Meeting
items.description: Grand interior hall with red carpet and portrait paintings; a Terran emperor figure in a red cape stands beside a Protoss character. Campaign cinematic throne room interior.

items.name: Void Rock — Energy Vein Lightning Terrain
items.description: Dark cinematic aerial of cracked rocky terrain with pulsing violet-white energy veins cutting diagonally across the surface. Combat explosions glow on the left; atmospheric fog fills the frame.

items.name: Void Crater — Blue Energy Core
items.description: Aerial perspective of a dark rocky crater with a glowing blue energy pool at its center. Barren, cracked terrain with atmospheric haze; no units visible — terrain showcase or cinematic scene.

items.name: Protoss Mothership Core — Beam Strike on Terran Ruins
items.description: A Protoss Mothership Core fires a blue-orange energy beam into cracked ash terrain flanked by ruined Terran industrial structures. Close-up isometric view of impact point.

items.name: Dark Cinematic — Zerg vs Terran Interior Encounter
items.description: Dark cinematic frame; Zerg units (Roach-like and Hydralisk-like) face a Terran unit at right in a dim industrial interior lit by a red overhead light. Low visibility, campaign cutscene style.

items.name: Zerg Cave Tileset — Underground Swarm
items.description: Lush underground cave tileset with green crystal formations, a waterfall, and numerous small Zerg units (spider-like, Zergling-scale) swarming the mossy floor. SC1-era visual style.

items.name: Terran Space Platform — Cylindrical Tower Walkway
items.description: Terran space-station tileset showing a narrow walkway beside massive cylindrical industrial towers. A Protoss unit stands on the platform; stars and sandy terrain visible through openings.

items.name: Terran Dominion City — Obedience Propaganda Screen
items.description: Terran Dominion urban tileset featuring a large billboard reading "Obedience is safety." with the Dominion emblem. A Terran statue, military vehicles, and numbered bays are visible.

items.name: Terran Dominion Staging Area — Heavy Mech Platform
items.description: Terran Dominion industrial base with a large yellow walker-class mech on a red-carpeted platform, flanked by Terran infantry and armored vehicles. Dominion facility tileset.

items.name: Terran Dominion City — Protecting You From Yourself
items.description: Terran Dominion urban tileset with a propaganda billboard reading "Protecting you From Yourself!" and the Dominion chevron. Long columns of Terran ground vehicles fill the right side.

items.name: Terran Battlestation — Close Underbelly View
items.description: Close-range view from below a massive dark Terran space platform or battle station with a cross-shaped truss frame and thruster plumes firing. Bright blue sky background.

items.name: Terran Battlestation — Full View with Escort Fleet
items.description: Wide-angle view of a massive cross-shaped Terran battle station in flight above a rain-streaked blue atmosphere, accompanied by several smaller Terran warships below it.

items.name: Underwater Tileset — Terran Mech on Seafloor
items.description: Submerged rocky seafloor tileset with a Terran mech unit standing beside a wrecked military vehicle. Dark green aquatic environment; game UI health bars visible.

items.name: Underwater Protoss Ruins — Terran Mech Explorer
items.description: Underwater cave tileset featuring ornate Protoss architectural ruins and a blue crystal. A Terran mech unit navigates the dark green seafloor near the ancient structure.

items.name: Underwater Protoss Hub Structure — Terran Unit
items.description: Submerged circular Protoss-style hub complex embedded in rocky seafloor. A Terran mech unit is positioned at the center of the structure; game UI visible.

items.name: Underwater Industrial Corridor Junction — Terran Mech
items.description: Dark underwater industrial tileset showing a Terran mech unit at a cross-junction of reinforced metal corridors. Rocky seafloor surroundings; game UI visible in corner.

items.name: Aquatic Submerged Terrain — Protoss Unit in Water
items.description: Aquatic tileset with submerged rocky platforms, floating bubbles, pale pink spores, and aquatic vegetation. A Protoss unit navigates the blue-tinted underwater environment.

items.name: Aquatic Submerged Terrain — Misty Underwater View
items.description: Misty underwater tileset with submerged rock formations, bubble particles, and aquatic plants. A Protoss unit is visible among the rocky outcroppings in the hazy blue-grey water.

items.name: SC2 Editor — Underwater Ice Cave Terrain Preview
items.description: SC2 map editor perspective view of an underwater or ice cave tileset from outside map bounds, showing the terrain plane suspended over a starfield with dome structures visible below.

items.name: Desert Sand — Collapsed Protoss Ruins with Mining Convoy
items.description: Sandy desert tileset with large collapsed Protoss arch ruins half-buried in dunes, lit by glowing green trim. Terran mining trucks and tiny infantry figures are active nearby.

items.name: (LotV) Xel'Naga Vault — Cerebrate Chamber
items.description: Dark Protoss/Xel'Naga interior hall with cyan-glowing geometric panels. A large Zerg cerebrate-like creature looms at the far end while a Terran marine stands in the foreground.

items.name: (LotV) Xel'Naga Corridor — Crystal Approach
items.description: A long Protoss corridor lined with blue crystal formations leads to a Zerg cerebrate-like entity at the end. Dark sci-fi tileset with teal accent lighting; cinematic campaign framing.

items.name: Protoss Dark Gateway Deco — Editor Preview
items.description: Isolated editor-preview shot of two tall dark Protoss pillars with cyan chevron glyphs flanking a smaller glowing gateway structure, set against a pure black background.

items.name: (LotV) Protoss Army — Jungle Ruins March
items.description: Large Protoss army including zealots, stalkers, and immortals with blue energy shields advancing through a misty jungle canyon with waterfalls and ancient stone ruins. Likely a LotV campaign deployment scene.

items.name: (LotV) Protoss Column — Jungle Temple Approach
items.description: Aerial view of a massed Protoss force marching single-file through a foggy jungle corridor flanked by tall ancient Protoss architecture. Dense tropical tileset with palm foliage.

items.name: (LotV) Protoss Patrol — Jungle Waterfall Pass
items.description: Small Protoss patrol with zealots and stalkers moving through a misty forest valley with cascading waterfalls and crumbling Protoss ruins. Tall conifers frame the scene.

items.name: Zerg Arena Chamber — Dark Boss Room
items.description: Dark enclosed arena of Zerg or Xel'Naga design with spike-crystal walls, two green glowing floor circles, and a green-lit doorway at the rear. Empty duel-room layout; no units present.

items.name: Terran Combat — Snow Tileset Skirmish
items.description: Aerial view of Terran Siege Tanks and small infantry engaged on a snowy tileset with rocky ridges and barren dead trees. Artillery impact arcs are visible in the snow.

items.name: Terran Research Base — Lunar Tileset
items.description: Overhead view of a large Terran installation on a grey lunar-like barren tileset, featuring a circular command hub, multiple connected modules, and scattered defensive units.

items.name: (WoL) Terran Compound — Desert Shield Defense
items.description: Terran base enclosed by a bright blue energy shield on a sandy desert tileset. Solar panels, infantry squads, and wheeled vehicles are visible outside the perimeter.

items.name: Terran Desert Outpost — Industrial Tileset
items.description: Close aerial view of a Terran heavy-industry installation on a sandy desert tileset, with tall silos, a mechanical crane arm, infantry, and supply structures under dramatic side-lighting.

items.name: (WoL) Jungle Ruins — Terran and Zerg Flora
items.description: Mixed Terran units including a mech and marines near ancient overgrown ruins in a jungle tileset. Zerg sunflower-like flora and a deep pit dominate the centre of the scene.

items.name: (LotV) Protoss Shrine — Dark Temple Confrontation
items.description: Ground-level cinematic inside a dark Protoss temple. Protoss zealots surround a glowing blue crystal pylon-shrine while a robed figure in red stands nearby among tall organic Protoss architecture.

items.name: (LotV) Protoss Sanctum — Crystal Shrine Arena
items.description: Aerial view of a circular Protoss sanctum with a tall glowing crystal shrine at the centre, surrounded by Protoss heroes and warriors on a tiled floor with curved stone walls.

items.name: (LotV) Protoss Unit — Forest River Crossing

items.name: Forest River Tileset — Rocky Stream

items.name: Zerg Corrupted Tileset — Idol Shrine Pit

items.name: Campaign Interior — Alien Structure Dark Hall

items.name: Arcade Interior — Conference Room Under Attack
items.description: Same conference room in chaos: a large Zerg or Hybrid creature at the table, ghost-like spectral units, an active fireplace, and a soccer ball. Arcade event map interior.

items.name: Arcade Interior — Conference Room Wide View
items.description: Wide-angle view of an ornate conference room with a long table, spectral ghost units, a Protoss/Zerg entity, vases, and a soccer ball prop. Custom arcade map interior tileset.

items.name: Holiday Arcade Map — Christmas Tree Snow Arena
items.description: Decorated Christmas tree with glowing star topper on an icy snow tileset, surrounded by Terran Hellions and holiday gift decorations. Seasonal arcade event map.

items.name: Holiday Arcade Map — Christmas Tree Base Detail

items.name: Holiday Arcade Map — Christmas Tree Star Topper

items.name: Campaign Interior — Elegant Corridor Blue Carpet

items.name: Campaign Interior — Corridor Confrontation
items.description: Same ornate palace corridor; an armed male figure crouches approaching two female characters near a door. Campaign encounter scene with blue carpet and warm wall lighting.

items.name: Campaign Interior — Corridor Vehicle Approach
items.description: Ornate palace hallway with a small vehicle or turret on the blue carpet, and two female characters standing in the background. Campaign interior mission scene.

items.name: (WoL) Terran Urban — Street Level Combat
items.description: Ground-level cinematic of Terran Marines and a heavy mech battling in an industrial street strewn with Zerg corpses. Dominion flag visible; dark urban campaign tileset.

items.name: Campaign Interior — Palace Grand Hall Aftermath
items.description: White marble grand hall with sweeping staircases, an ornamental fountain, and fallen bodies on a blood-stained floor. Post-battle palace interior, likely campaign scene.

items.name: Campaign Interior — Palace Throne Stairs Massacre

items.name: Campaign Interior — Palace Hall Panorama

items.name: Terran Palace Hall — Grand Foyer

items.name: Terran Palace Interior — Dining Hall
items.description: Elegant indoor conference or dining room with gold-trimmed bookshelves, potted plants, and blue-paneled tables. Blood stains and debris suggest a violent assault on this upscale Terran interior.

items.name: Terran Palace — Ceremonial Rotunda
items.description: Sweeping overhead view of a grand white marble rotunda with a central fountain, symmetrical staircases, and Terran faction banners. Blood and fallen figures litter the polished floor below.

items.name: Terran Palace — Private Study
items.description: Candlelit private study with a bookshelf, ornate rug, armillary sphere, and a large window showing a twilight cityscape painting. Luxury Terran interior tileset suggesting a noble's quarters.

items.name: Desert Outpost — Mixed Faction Settlement
items.description: Top-down view of a sandy desert tileset showing a circular settlement with Terran structures, shipping containers, Zerg creep, and mixed units. Likely an arcade or custom map scenario.

items.name: Desert Combat — Terran Forward Base
items.description: Sandy desert tileset close-up with Terran structures, a landing pad, vehicles, and heavy Zerg casualties on the ground. Dead trees and blood indicate a recently contested outpost.

items.name: Desert Tileset — Fortified Terran Outpost

items.name: Snow Tileset — Aerial Cliff Crossing
items.description: Wide aerial shot of a snow and ice tileset with rocky cliffs bordering a frozen expanse. A single small Terran vehicle traverses the snowy plain between cliff faces, with a green forest patch visible.

items.name: Snow Tileset — Cliff Pass Aerial View
items.description: Alternate aerial angle of a snow and rocky cliff tileset with a Terran vehicle near a mountain pass. Blue-tinted icy ground contrasts with grey rock ridges and a small coastal strip.

items.name: Jungle Mist — Aerial Vehicle Traverse

items.name: Floating Island — Terran Platform Base
items.description: Dark Terran installation on a floating rock island surrounded by mist and jungle-covered floating terrain. Aerial tileset suggesting a custom arcade or editor map with cloud-level platforms.

items.name: Jungle Ravine — Sci-Fi Suspension Bridge

items.name: Jungle River — Command Center on Fire

items.name: Urban Highway — Night Road Scene
items.description: Dark urban highway tileset with armored Terran vehicles, a cargo truck carrying green canisters, and crashed or burning vehicles on a multi-lane road. Night city road environment.

items.name: Terran Water Feature — Circular Fountain Plaza

items.name: Xel'Naga Ruin — Misty Arch Overhead

items.name: Protoss Ruin Interior — Spire Courtyard

items.name: Beach Tileset — Pier Tiki Hut with Sailboat
